items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Of course, the young Lorenzo was married to one of the boatswain. ... He wasn't an old man Lorenzo's only son.

ctx.x: Yeah, you wouldn't want to question him too, actually.

So I never got very much about that. The only thing I knew he used to speak about, he used to show me his old books of harmony, and tell me this and that and the other and so forth. And he could harmonize in any key you want, any key. And part is a soft way, you know what I'm saying? You could be singing here and you'd change key and everything else, he'd tell you the key you changed to. All he wanted to know, where you began. Yeah. He'd get, he'd get an idea of a keynote of what key you're singing in. He'd give…
